summary: A 100-foot Aermotor steel tower in Chickasaw County, Mississippi, with an unknown build date and little documented history beyond its 2022 historic register listing.

facts.design: 100 ft steel Aermotor tower with a parallel internal staircase
facts.status_note: Lowest flight of steps removed, per a February 5, 2022 site visit; footings of an earlier tower remain on the same site.

events.note: Listed on the National Historic Lookout Register July 12, 2022 (US 1676, MS 39), nominated by Jason Johns.

notes_for_editor: Only substantive source found was the NHLR register page (cached locally); no FFLOS page, newspaper, NRHP nomination, or Forest Service history turned up for this specific tower in two WebSearch queries plus WebFetch checks (anyplaceamerica.com 403'd; Wikipedia's Woodland, MS article has nothing on the tower). No build year, staffing, or fire history available. Fact-check pass removed two unsupported details from the story: a claim that the tower sits near a 'small community of Woodland' (not stated on the NHLR page) and an attribution of the 2022 site visit to 'NHLR volunteers' specifically (the register page records only that a site visit occurred, not who performed it). All other claims verified directly against the cached NHLR page and the Wikipedia Mississippi Forestry Commission article.
